a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first gives us only about a 4% chance of getting to round 3. Waiting likely means we both lose. I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, so I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we may both end up short, so please don't take this round. If the storm holds off, I'll operate with you every round after that until you have 4 too. I'll keep you posted honestly each round.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry to break the plan, but I didn't want to hide it. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs and you can get your 4. I won't take any more cells.
Operating as promised. The reserve is at 0, so two rounds of us both operating gets it to 4, and then you take all 4. I'll keep operating until you have 4.
